title: Maryam Mirzakhani's birth chart
metaDescription: Maryam Mirzakhani's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 21.4° Taurus. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Tightest of all, Venus holds a opposition to Pluto at 0.3° — close enough to weld taste to depth. An opposition is the tradition’s tug of war. Both ends are real, and the work is holding them at once rather than picking a winner.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At the noon reference the Sun sits 21.4° into Taurus — the third decan, which the old scheme hands to Saturn. Same sign, different decan, different chart.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: Mercury holds 4.8° Taurus, Venus holds 12.1° Aries, Mars holds 11.3° Aries — in the old shorthand, thought with its feet on the ground; attraction declared rather than implied; effort spent in bursts and openings.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The tightest geometry in the chart puts Venus directly across the wheel from Pluto, 0.3° off exact. The scheme reads an opposition as a axis to walk, not a fight to win: the chart keeps both ends lit. Behind it, Mars trine Saturn at 0.5°, and Mars opposition Pluto at 0.6° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: Venus, Saturn, Neptune close a triangle of trines. Three trines close into a circuit the tradition calls a grand trine — ease so complete it can idle unnoticed for years. Mercury opposes Uranus while both square Saturn. Two squares braced against one opposition make a t-square — the chart’s working end, where pressure keeps finding the same outlet.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags four placements in this chart. Venus in Aries at 12.1° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Mars in Aries at 11.3° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Jupiter in Gemini at 8.3° is in detriment; Saturn in Leo at 10.8° is in detriment. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Among the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the elements divide 4 fire, 2 earth, 2 water, 2 air; by modality, 4 fixed, 3 mutable, 3 cardinal. Mercury, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Pisces for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.6° between midnight and midnight. The sign survives the missing hour; the degree does not, and is given as a reference rather than a fact. At the noon reference it stands at 17.1°.
